scope: Instant source reproduce_kb ledger only; not independently generated ecological-history trajectories, not natural island data.
purpose: At fixed 4 visitor type IDs and the SAME plant diploid genotype/census, separate optima-shift effects on group seeds and individual/group β/Γ conflict that are mediated by total exported pollen amount from changes remaining after equalizing total export.
source_assurance: evolving / delayed selfing; ovule_budget 8; original pollen, seed and depression laws
activity_adjustment: For each state/visitor-breadth/effectiveness cell, change ONLY activity scalar of the shifted4 visitor arm by monotone root-finding to match reference4 total exported pollen within absolute 1e-8. Keep optima, 4 IDs, breadth, effectiveness, adult genotype and N fixed. Baseline activity is the canonical 0.4. This is a controlled numerical equality, not an observed behavioral response.
primary_descriptive_contrasts: shifted_original_activity minus reference_original_activity in viable seeds and β/Γ source signs (includes different total pollen export)
shifted_export_matched minus reference_original_activity (eliminates total pollen export difference, but allows pollen recipient/donor allocation and mating changes)
shifted_export_matched minus shifted_original_activity (numerically forced activity effect within shifted visitor setting)
material_controls: Source original reproduction functions only; no code/biology mutation.
All 108 rows retained even where source beta/gamma sign does not flip.
Exact same 8 adult three-locus diploid array within each triad.
Original same-four optimum spacing retained; only optimum location shifted by +0.2.
4 visitor IDs, per-type breadth and per-type effectiveness constant within triads.
Total exported pollen difference of export_matched and reference <= 1e-8, or abort; do not silently drop failures.
Validate the 0.2 matching / 0.18 breadth / effectiveness 1 baseline and shifted seeds and β/Γ against the archived prior 16-condition source fixture.
Do not report significance p-values treating 36 synthetic blocks as sampled independently from natural ecosystems.
known_identification_limit: Holding total exported pollen equal is not holding total deposited pollen or pollinator visit number equal. It is NOT natural causal mediation, since source-match activity can change channel saturation, delivery distribution, and transfer. If any optima shifts remain, only the model's matching/partition mechanisms are implicated.
expected_execution: Runner emits 108-row complete JSON, independent SHA-256 provenance, source-block contrasts and numerical identification checks. Source-head CI must pass before numerical claims.
future: Use observed single-visit deposition, legitimate handling, and plant-level maternal/paternal success to test beyond this mathematical source; independent histories only if persistence claims needed.
